title: CI/CD & Release Engineering: Cloud Deploy — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Automated Canary Rollback: Cloud Monitoring detects HTTP 500 error spike in canary pods and triggers instant 100% traffic diversion back to baseline.
routing_rationale: Automated rollback removes human panic during bad deployments, returning the system to a known good state in seconds.

nodes.label: Canary HTTP 500 Errors
nodes.detail: Canary microservice throws NullPointerException on real customer shopping carts.

nodes.label: Cloud Monitoring MQL Alert
nodes.detail: Detects canary error rate > 1% threshold within 15 seconds.

nodes.label: Cloud Deploy Auto-Rollback
nodes.detail: Reverts Gateway API route weights: 100% to v1.0, 0% to canary.

nodes.label: Stable Pods Absorb 100% Traffic
nodes.detail: Error rate drops back to 0.01% immediately; customer impact resolved.

steps.title: Defect Detection
steps.action: Watchdog detects 8.2% error rate in canary and signals Cloud Deploy rollback.
steps.why_traversal: Catches application regressions before they reach the general user population.

steps.title: Instantaneous Rollback Execution
steps.action: Gateway route weight shifts 100% traffic back to v1.0; defective pods terminated.
steps.why_traversal: Restores production reliability in under 15 seconds.

scenarios.label: Destructive DB Schema Change Prevents Rollback
scenarios.root_cause: v1.1 executed destructive SQL migration dropping a column required by v1.0.
scenarios.diverted_path: Rollback failed; v1.0 pods crashed because required column was missing.
scenarios.blast_radius: Full production outage requiring manual database restoration.
scenarios.recovery: Enforce expand-and-contract database migration pattern: never drop columns in the same release as code changes.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
